planned_change: Use the existing BCL non-generic Enum.TryParse(Type,string,out object) instead of closing and reflectively invoking a generic helper. Do not introduce a metadata/delegate cache.
producer: Actual EnumTypeModelBinder and CollectionModelBinder<RegularEnum> consume FormValueProvider values and produce real ModelState. Actual GenerateSelect renders selected options.
compatibility: All nine new producer/current-values/rendered-options rows pass individually on original and changed source.
Preserve exact current-value sets and rendered option selection for names, whitespace, casing, numeric undefined values, comma combinations, invalid text, nullable empty and multiple selection.
Preserve actual successful and failed model-binding outcomes; do not assume the binder and rendering parser have identical casing/defined-value rules.
Existing enum-conversion cases and full owning ViewFeatures suite pass.
No exported API, default or persistent cache changes; trim/dynamic-code constraints are not expanded.

measurement.owner: Actual public DefaultHtmlGenerator.GetCurrentValues, using real MVC metadata and binder-produced ModelState. No copied enum parser and no timed reflection.
measurement.controls: Non-enum strings, typed enum values, nullable/empty and one/multiple values as feasible.
measurement.early_stop: A clear large improvement around50 percent can stop after one comparison; retain every regression, heap cost and setup limitation.
measurement.scope: Helper CPU and managed allocations, with actual selected-option rendering checked separately. No HTTP-throughput claim.
